title: Visual Oddball Task (256 channels)
description: High-density (256-channel) EEG recordings from a visual oddball selective attention task collected in 2004 at the Swartz Center for Computational Neuroscience, UCSD. The dataset extends an earlier 32-channel corpus using the same experimental paradigm, and adds scanned electrode positions and anatomical MRI to allow precise source localization. Events are annotated with HED tags.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 256-channel BioSemi system and referenced to electrode 135. BDF files were fused with stimulus presentation information, and spurious events were removed. HED tags were added, and electrode positions were scanned. Anatomical MRI was converted to NIfTI format.
